description: Ask the user to take over a tab, sign in, pass a captcha, enter a code, and wait until they say they are done (up to `seconds`, default 300; call again to keep waiting). A sign-in is yours first: a way in the snapshot names under `signs in with:` (Continue with Google), sign_in for a saved password, a mailed code; hand it over only when those can't. A sign-in handed over ends by itself once the tab is back on the site. It shows as one line at the page's foot. For something that would help but the task can go on without (reading chats behind a QR sign-in), pass optional: the line stays for the user, with Skip, and you carry on at once instead of waiting.

detail.description: Anything more, shown only if they open it

optional.description: The task can go on without it: don't wait

reason.description: What the user should do, at most 60 characters, e.g. Sign in to Google

tab.description: Tab id, as `open` or `tabs` gave it

name: handoff
title: Hand Over to the User
